clarify-requirement.rationale: "More reliable" is read as: the analytics executor submission must not be able to throw an uncaught exception on the request thread, while analytics stays fully async. Rejecting the synchronous-write interpretation -- it silently reverses the documented latency guarantee on the redirect path for a benefit (zero click loss) nobody asked for.

implementation.rationale: The approved interpretation is a small, defensive, backward-compatible change to the redirect path. Approved for the same reason the rejected interpretation was declined: this one preserves the async latency guarantee instead of reversing it.
